title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Suggested Abbreviations
summary: Reference guide listing standard abbreviations for Dynamics 365 Business Central object types, word abbreviations used in naming conventions, and financial/time period abbreviations. Useful when developing or documenting AL code to follow Microsoft naming conventions.
key_points: Object types have abbreviations like Page, Codeunit, Table, Query, and Report for file naming
Common words in Dynamics 365 have standardized short forms such as Cust for customer, Inv for invoice, and Whse for warehouse
Financial metrics and time periods use abbreviations like YTD (Year to Date), PY (Previous Year), and FY (Fiscal Year)
Following these conventions ensures consistency across development and documentation in Business Central

quotes.text: Use the listed abbreviations for each type of object in the file naming
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the standard for consistent AL object naming across Business Central development

quotes.text: I have re-compiled the list here, and I hope this serves as a helpful reference for anyone in need
quotes.why_it_matters: The post recreates a previously unavailable Microsoft abbreviations guide, making it a practical resource for developers
